payload.title: Connect the Rich reviewer to the complete core flywheel
payload.description:
## Scope and acceptance
Consume public core prediction, feedback, optimization and event APIs; no application-owned second optimizer/head. Include/Exclude/Skip, optional explanation, undo, resume and predictions visible as requested. Clearly mark recommendation-visible labels as potentially anchored. Display running pre-vote agreement, audit estimates with counts/uncertainty, active version/features, recent optimizer prompts/replies/tools, proposed edits, fitting and promotions/failures. Do not stop at ten samples; show warm-up/insufficient-positive-label state. Cross-repo prerequisite: decision-flywheel-e1e92986-a121-410a-b8c2-fb467d6b3d88. Offline integration tests first; bounded live demo only after protocol approval.
